skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Attacks a single target with 3 consecutive strikes, dealing 135% ATK DMG.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Increases own CRIT DMG by 30% for 1 round. Deals Direct DMG equal to 105% of Max HP to all enemies in a column with 3 consecutive strikes and additionally deals [Specialized Extra DMG] equal to 120% of own original Max HP. Each layer of [Momentum] increases [Specialized Extra DMG]%. [Specialized Extra DMG]: Can CRIT and is unaffected by [Specialized DMG Reflect].

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Increases own CRIT DMG by 50% for 1 round. Deals Direct DMG equal to 135% of Max HP to all enemies in a column with 3 consecutive strikes and additionally deals [Specialized Extra DMG] equal to 140% of own original Max HP. Each layer of [Momentum] increases [Specialized Extra DMG] by 25%. [Specialized Extra DMG]: Can CRIT and is unaffected by [Specialized DMG Reflect].

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently gains 60% [Non-Crit DMG Free]. Gains 1500 Energy points before taking an action. [Non-Crit DMG Free]: Effective against all types of DMG and cannot coexist with [Agility].

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently gains 65% [Non-Crit DMG Free]. Gains 2000 Energy points before taking an action. [Non-Crit DMG Free]: Effective against all types of DMG and cannot coexist with [Agility].

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently gains 70% [Non-Crit DMG Free]. Gains 2500 Energy points before taking an action. [Non-Crit DMG Free]: Effective against all types of DMG and cannot coexist with [Agility].

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: At the start of each round, restores own HP equal to 200% of Max HP for up to 4 rounds. Allies in the same row restore HP equal to 80% of Metal Bat’s Max HP for up to 4 rounds. Before any character takes action, own [HP Shield] permanently increases [Momentum]. Increases own CRIT Rate by 50% and increases all allies’ CRIT Rate by 30%. [Momentum]: Each layer of [Excess Recovery] grants 1 layer of [Momentum], up to 4 layers. The number of [Momentum] layers is calculated based on the highest number of Metal Bat’s [Excess Recovery] layers.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: At the start of each round, restores own HP equal to 250% of Max HP for up to 4 rounds. Allies in the same row restore HP equal to 120% of Metal Bat’s Max HP for up to 4 rounds. Before any character takes action, own [HP Shield] permanently increases [Momentum]. Increases own CRIT Rate by 70% and increases all allies’ CRIT Rate by 50%. [Momentum]: Each layer of [Excess Recovery] grants 1 layer of [Momentum], up to 6 layers. The number of [Momentum] layers is calculated based on the highest number of Metal Bat’s [Excess Recovery] layers.
